entities.summary: Miroslav Šašek was a Czech writer illustrator. He emigrated from Czechoslovakia to Switzerland, and lived also in France and West Germany. He is best known for a series of books for children, originally published by W. H. Allen & Co., titled This Is..., which he signed M. Sasek.
